name: The Loveliest Solves on the Plains Auburn 2026

venue.name: Auburn University Academic Classroom and Laboratory Complex

information:
**Note: Competitors under the age of 19 must be accompanied by a parent/guardian at all times.**

This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/LoveliestSolvesAuburn2026#70589-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission.

![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5MDYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--55d04463db7d97e68854ce1ad4ffb960c1ed23fd/SOUTHEAST_5.png)

This competition is organized by the Cubing Club at Auburn University! **Auburn students, faculty, and alumni are eligible for a reduced registration fee of $15.** After registering, contact the organizers via the "Contact" link at the top left of this page and send a screenshot of your GET Mobile app, a photo of your Tiger Card, or other proof of enrollment/employment to the organizers to qualify for the reduced registration of $15.
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTIxNTEzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--f266a967895300fe1ed5bf819c8e27b0c30155fa/image0.webp)
